up: For the parent compound CHEMBL376359 and all of its related salts identified via molecule_hierarchy parent mapping, retrieve activity details where the bioactivity is against target CHEMBL284. The output must include only IC50 measurements in nM. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, otherwise DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the FAQ salts join semantics: filter compounds by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, then join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not join activities on molregno and do not join docs through assays.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT
    parent.molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mh.molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cs_set
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cs_set.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
